verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing a hosted email API is a plausible choice for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence says AgentMail's source is published under an open license. The skills package installed via npx, SDKs, a CLI binary and Bring Your Own Cloud are adjacent offerings, not an openly licensed product codebase.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
